name: a2a-router
purpose: An order passport and trust infrastructure for agent-assisted manufacturing. Post-labor is the long-term vision; manufacturing is the first market.

mcp.note: a2a-router exposes a public HTTPS-only bridge router. Local, private, reserved, multicast, and documentation IP targets are blocked. Registry and settlement are not live yet.

contact.direct: Pilot inquiries: email go@vibe-manufacturing.com with your part, quantity, existing supplier or quotes, and target date.

limitations: Brief preparation does not submit an RFQ, contact a manufacturer or take payment. Saving a local order is a separate human action.
The published Trust-Pledge and signed Agent Card remain historical, self-attested bridge metadata.
Order events are self-reported and stored in the browser. No central verified ledger, factory audit, buyer protection or escrow service is available here yet.
Bridge calls accept public HTTPS targets only; private and reserved networks are blocked.
The bridge does not persist credentials or sessions; streaming and push notifications are not implemented.

planned.factoryAttestations: Paid evidence review of identity, capabilities and certificate scope; not yet available.
planned.orderLedger: Persistent evidence-backed order events, delivery, acceptance, disputes and payment; not yet available.
planned.settlement: Provider-managed milestone payments after buyer acceptance; no escrow or payments on this site today.

pilot.name: Guided Manufacturing Pilot
pilot.primaryCustomers: Small US hardware teams and product studios

price.basis: One-time fee for one guided order; applicable taxes specified in the proposal.

pilot.scope: One part, one supplier, one order: a kickoff, structured brief, comparison of up to three buyer-provided quotes, milestone plan, acceptance checklist, and exportable order passport using buyer and supplier evidence.
pilot.inquiryMethod: Email: the website opens a draft in the visitor’s mail app. The visitor must review and send it. No web submission or checkout.
pilot.nextStep: Scope, timeline and fee confirmed in writing before the customer decides to proceed and receives an invoice. No charge or commitment to inquire.
pilot.note: Personally guided service. Supplier communication and payments happen outside the software. No completed pilots, independently audited factories or central production ledger orders are published here.

optionalHandoffs.note: Optional external service; no automatic transfer.
